preconditions.description: The number of employees is between 1 and 2000, inclusive.
Each pi denotes the immediate manager for the i-th employee, where pi = -1 indicates that the i-th employee does not have an immediate manager.
No employee will be the immediate manager of themselves.

preconditions.expression: There will be no managerial cycles
preconditions.description: There will not exist an employee who is the superior of his/her own immediate manager.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of groups that can be formed such that no employee is the superior of another employee within the same group.
